test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre. One pair of the person are sitting each side of the table and no person is sitting at corner.

i. B is facing D and is sitting to the right of E.

ii. F, who is neighbour of D, is facing G.

iii. There are two persons between C and H, and H is not facing E.

Who might be sitting between C and E, if there is only person between them?
solution:
Eight friends: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H.

**i.** B is facing D and is sitting to the right of E.

**ii.** F, who is neighbour of D, is facing G.

From the above statements the sitting arrangement is as given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5a96b9f2de22e6dd4a409453fd6238d2f796c2a7869f2a8a7c81df0fcb8e411.png] 

**iii. **There are two persons between C and H, and H is not facing E.

From this statement, there are 3 cases possible:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a36ff9bcef4cf9c7df8f358c59712253bbd246262416f682844c953dafad917.png] 

 
• Now, one place is remaining, and "A" is remaining to sit. so A will sit on that place.
 
• So, the final sitting arrangement of 8 friends is as given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92d3457d0fbf81dd66d4a46368eb8b4b53d9d32e1bb4dac40421132f18855c10.png] 

 
• Now, the question says there is only person between C and E. So, cases 1 and 3 are eliminated.
 
• In figure (2), when counted from the right of E, we can see that there is only one person between E and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1471de4a67bc8c45b09142ccd350d675c8adb733d0af026c36514df90e2fee9.png] 

As we can see from the figure (2),** "B"** is sitting between E and C.

Hence, the correct answer is** "B"**.
